keyboardOffset.description: The offset value when swiper is moved from the keyboard.

interactive.description: When true, users can add/remove layers from the swiper and choose the revealed side directly from the layer settings panel. When false, the swiper stays static.

layers.description: The layers participating in the swiper, each with the side of the bar on which the layer is revealed.

layerPath.description: The layer path participating in the swiper.

side.description: The visible side of the swiper bar for this layer. Use left/right for a vertical bar and up/down for a horizontal bar.

version.description: The schema version used to validate the configuration file. The schema should enumerate the list of versions accepted by this version of the viewer.
